'''Threnda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Bomu Clan]], an underworld [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] clan that operated during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Threnda operated a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Teg Kithri]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Budpock]], which she used as a front for an operation distributing the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]] on behalf of the Bomu. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] set out to shut down the Tempest trade. They confronted Threnda and her [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] assistant [[Mitt]] in the warehouse behind the back of her cantina, and they subsequently used a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] to destroy her supplies of the spice, much to Threnda's protest.
